name: Qiqi
quote: I am Qiqi. I am a zombie. And I... forgot what comes next.
description: A girl who was reanimated as an undead by the adepti after her death, now cared for by Baizhu and working at Bubu Pharmacy in Liyue Harbor. A sigil on her forehead stabilizes what remains of her soul, though it leaves her with severe memory problems.
